assets.name: living
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photoreal interior design comparison website photograph, scheme 雾蓝与燕麦.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing living/dining room. EDIT THIS EXACT PHOTO; maintain the identical camera, viewpoint, lens perspective, image framing and 3:2 landscape aspect ratio. Preserve all architecture and fixed geometry precisely: the dark walnut architectural wall paneling, TV on the far left and its cabinet, glass opening on the left, rear dining area with table/chairs and pendant, entry door and every opening, sideboard, art placements, ceiling recesses, beams and all ceiling lamps. Preserve room dimensions and furniture placement footprints; no redesign or enlargement.
Change only these furnishings/materials within the original photo. Replace the sofa on the right, in its exact position and approximate footprint, with a sophisticated low smoky steel-blue velvet sofa: fully upholstered arms, tailored seat/back cushions, believable slight compression, tactile fine nap, no wooden arms. Use refined cream/oatmeal and muted smoky-blue accent cushions with natural cloth texture. Replace the coffee table in its same footprint with a pale warm limestone/travertine table, rounded low silhouette, softly eased stone edges and a slim recessed dark base; preserve tasteful existing objects on top. Replace the rug, preserving its floor perspective and location under sofa/table, with tightly hand-knotted oyster-grey to oatmeal wool/silk-look pile: subtle tonal gradient, densely fine surface, slight pile direction in the light, fine bound edges, refined low pile, natural shadows/contact under all furniture, no coarse jute, no braided loops, no knitted ropes. Change existing warm grey large-format floor to pale greige stone with real fine joints, subtle mineral variation and convincing reflections, visually distinct from walnut.
Style/medium: high-detail architectural photography of a fully furnished real home, a coherent single photograph, physically integrated furniture and material finishes. Photographic microtexture and realistic scale; rich walnut balanced against smoky blue and oatmeal. Neutral white balance with warm local lamps and soft natural illumination; eliminate the heavy overall orange cast while retaining localized warm light. Soft, physically grounded contact shadows, natural material reflections and fine fabric detail. Output one complete full-frame 3:2 image at high native detail, not an artificially upscaled image.
Constraints: identical camera/framing/architecture/openings and fixed geometry to input. No extra objects or architectural additions. No composited furniture stickers, no 3D overlays, no CG toy appearance, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no collage.
